name: Dora Dobrotić — a son Jacobus baptised in 1871, Križovljan Radovečki, Croatia
researcher_question: Which children were born to Dora (Dorothea) Dobrotić, born about 1841 at Veliki Lovrečan, Varaždin, Croatia, and her husband Franjo Korotaj?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 7, hint-samples.csv row 228, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-21 as a false match (issue #3621): the hint's index entry (Jacobus Korota, bapt. 3 Apr 1871, Križovljan Radovečki, parents Franciscus Korota and Dorothea Dobrotić) does not match the register image, where entry #22 is Georgius, son of Josephus Horvat vel Korotaj and Theresia, of Virje N. 8. Findings are an avoid guard on that son plus a required negative conclusion. The image reading was calibrated against two other indexed entries on the same page.
